svg.title: Missingness map: scheduled visits by participant and arm, observed, missed or after dropout
svg.desc: 36 participants, 7 visits each. Dropouts: Placebo 1 of 12, Low dose 1 of 12, High dose 8 of 12. Single missed visits: Placebo 4, Low dose 3, High dose 3. Missing cells are left empty or marked, never filled with values.
